snippet.title: Wheel of Fortune Daily (by Frosty Pop) Apple Arcade IOS Gameplay Video (HD)
snippet.description:
App description:

Fans have loved Wheel of Fortune for nearly 50 years. And now, Wheel of Fortune Daily turns America’s Game® into a simple, short, daily experience you can enjoy anytime and anywhere.

Longtime Wheel Watchers and word puzzle game fans will connect and have fun in Wheel of Fortune Daily with:

• New Puzzles Daily: Play classic Wheel of Fortune bonus puzzles. Start with RSTLNE and guess your own three consonants and a vowel to solve the puzzle!

• Endless Variety: Thousands of puzzles in all your favorite categories — from PEOPLE, PLACES, and THINGS to FUN & GAMES and more!

• Play Anywhere: Spin the Wheel and guess the right phrase online or offline! Perfect for quick play sessions any time and any place.

• Join the Community: Solve puzzles and earn in-game cash to work alongside other players and contribute to the global community leaderboard!

• Challenge Friends and Family: Compete online in Toss Up mode against friends, family, and fellow fans to earn cash and climb the leaderboards!

Wheel of Fortune Daily is a take on a favorite nightly television tradition, reimagined for iPhone, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro.


Reveal the fun and discover something new every day with this brain teasing game show trivia word game.

With nearly 20 million viewers continuing to tune in every week, Wheel of Fortune is one of the most successful syndicated game shows in television history. Join the fun and download Wheel of Fortune daily now.


Spin the Wheel, Solve the Puzzle, Win Big — Every Day!

App Store Link:https://apps.apple.com/de/app/wheel-of-fortune-daily/id6469643458?l=en-GB
